details.effect: When this card is discarded, put a Hellflame Dragon token into your EX area. ---------- [fanfare][cost03]: Summon a Hellflame Dragon token. Draw a card. [act][engage], discard a card: Put a Hellflame Dragon token into your EX area. This ability can be activated if Overflow is active for you.

issues: Fanfare ability is encoded incorrectly: '[fanfare][cost03]' is not an activated cost field here. It should be a fanfare ability with the 3 PP payment represented according to fanfare cost-line handling, not as an activated-style cost object on the ability.

Activated ability cost is encoded incorrectly: 'discard a card' should be represented as an implemented discard cost/effect, not 'cost.discard'. Change it to an implemented discard cost form if available, or model via an appropriate cost/effect wrapper.
Activated ability should note that it can be activated only if Overflow is active for you; condition is present, but because the discard cost is malformed the full ability is not correctly encoded.
